create_nat_loss_criterion: create a LabelSmoothedDualImitationCriterion instance with a task and label smoothing value for non-autoregressive training
compute_loss_with_label_smoothing: compute NLL loss with optional label smoothing on model outputs and targets using _compute_loss
run_forward_pass_nat_loss: run the forward pass to compute loss, sample size, and logging outputs for a given model and sample
reduce_metrics_for_distributed_training: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training workers and log loss, NLL loss, and perplexity metrics
add_nat_loss_args: add the label smoothing argument to the argument parser for the NAT loss criterion
